copy.calmStop: The elves are resting now, and so can you. The North Pole will be here.
copy.instructions: Walk with the arrow keys or the stick. Press Jump or the space bar to hop. Say hello to Jingle the elf at Santa's Landing.
copy.loading: Packing up the sleigh for the North Pole.

returns.label: Ride the sled back to Santa's Landing

zones.enterMessage: Welcome to Santa's Landing! Jingle the elf is here to help you. Walk up to Jingle to say hello. Press Jump to hop. Jumping is just for fun.
Christmas Village! Look at the big tree, Jingle says. The snow stairs are a nice walking way up. You can jump up the snow steps too.
Santa's Workshop! Tinker the elf needs your help with the toys. Walk up the long stairs to the high shelf, or hop up the crates.
Candy Cane Forest! Peppermint will show you the way. You can walk across the creek bridge, or hop over the peppermint stones.
The Frozen Lake! Frosty the elf skates here. Stay on the ice, and walk over the ice bridge when it appears.
Reindeer Stables! Noel looks after the reindeer. Follow the little footprints into Pine Hollow.
Gingerbread Village! Ginger and Mrs. Claus are baking. Walk up the sweet ramp to the rooftop, or hop on the cookies.
The North Road. Follow the lanterns to the next adventure. Jingle is cheering for you!
Snowflake Mountain! Climb the snowy stairs one step at a time. If you slip, you only slide down a little. Jingle will cheer you on.
The Observatory! Polaris studies the stars here. Walk up the ramp to the big dome.
